excludedFromThisProfile.scene: The scene has no Urban Duplex product, so every cabinet type is unplaced (runtime-bindings.json): no model or builder cabinet is placed until it has one.
excludedFromThisProfile.cabinetHeights: The cabinet style sets the height (DUP-CAB-001): 2DW 56 cm, 1DW and 1DWID 53 cm, the 1DW Slim cabinets 38 or 28 cm. The cabinet table forces 2DW:56, 1DW:53 and 1DWID:53, so the builder offers the standard heights only until the Slim styles are added; the presets keep their Slim heights.
excludedFromThisProfile.heightPairing: Which heights one composition may combine waits for DUP-CMP-01.
excludedFromThisProfile.lateralPanel: The lateral panel side is chosen per cabinet; its default R follows the renders (IMG #118, #122) until DUP-PNL-01. The handle groove is priced in the Lateral Panel colour until DUP-PNL-02.
excludedFromThisProfile.priceColumn: When the base and lateral panels are of different materials, the price server chooses the price column from the full SKU (DUP-SKU-01).
excludedFromThisProfile.shelves: Open Shelf 25-70 cm (UROS 2S at 56/53 cm, 1S at 38/28 cm) and Open Side Shelf 15 cm (UROSS) take the Urban Standard Height and Urban Low Height prices (Pricing!D397, D463); Urban Standard Height has no Open Side Shelf at 22.0H or 20.9H (DUP-SKU-02). The Open Shelf is priced in the Base Panel colour and the Open Side Shelf in the Lateral Panel colour, as the renders show them, until the client confirms.
excludedFromThisProfile.hybridModels: 28 models use Urban Standard Height or Urban Low Height cabinets without a lateral panel (Pre-Render | Hybrid Models): each preset product names its Series, and those cabinets are spelled VAN-URSTD-... or VAN-URLH-... with CAB in the Base Panel colour and HDL in the Lateral Panel colour.
excludedFromThisProfile.sideCabinetWidths: Side cabinets are 60-120 cm wide as Pricing lists them. SKU Curation also lists 25, 35 and 50 cm; the models take those from Urban Standard Height and Urban Low Height.
excludedFromThisProfile.pricingGaps: Pricing has the 2DW Side Cabinet at 50 cm deep only and the 1DW Side Cabinet at 15.0H and 46 cm deep only with the panel on the right; the cabinet table cannot express either.
excludedFromThisProfile.multiLevelModels: The five Multi-Level models are compact presets of the collection DPLX; the scene imports compact presets of Urban Low Height only.
excludedFromThisProfile.thickness: Thicknesses are Urban Standard Height's (P1064) as Urban Low Height's table 589 gives them: 1/2, 4 and 5-1/8 for HPL and Fenix, 1/2, 2-3/8, 4 and 5-1/2 for Porcelain. Offset, Remote and floating tops over the low cabinets are not modelled (GEN-TOP-23, DUP-TOP-02).
excludedFromThisProfile.solidSurfaceBasin: Solid-Surface: Rectangular has no row of its own; it is the Urban Standard Height candidate Top_Tekorlux_Rectangular until GEN-MAT-01.
excludedFromThisProfile.vesselSinks: The Master File lists no vessel sinks; only the vessel cutout is offered until the list is confirmed.
excludedFromThisProfile.colorCodes: The 232 cabinet colours of the Base Panel and the Lateral Panel are coded as Urban Standard Height and Urban Low Height code them (GEN-MAT-01).
excludedFromThisProfile.sidePanels: Side panels are sourced from Urban Standard Height and Urban Low Height (Pricing!A506) and wait for GEN-SP-01; not offered.
excludedFromThisProfile.dividers: Not offered: the Master File lists none for Urban Duplex (GEN-ACC-01).
excludedFromThisProfile.grainDirectionAndBookMatching: Not offered until the client answers GEN-STY-01.
excludedFromThisProfile.undermount: Not offered: the client has no undermount "currently" (GEN-TOP-15).
